newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed completes TracCell clinical trials.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed completes TracCell clinical trials.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said on Thursday it completed, ahead of schedule, clinical trials of its TracCell 2000 System, an automated slide mapping system to support Pap test primary screening.
It said the results show the safety and efficacy of its system.

The TracCell 2000 is a clinical laboratory diagnostic tool used in the primary screening process to map 100 percent of all slides and present all diagnostically relevant material to cytologists for their interpretation and diagnosis.

AccuMed said although its submission to the Food and Drug Administration needs to deal only with the safety and efficacy of the TracCell, ongoing studies are being completed to demonstrate improvements in productivity, quality and the reduced cost compared to alternative approaches, including the use of monolayer preparations.
